answer: Forged identities must bribe a quorum plus forfeit the stake, making sybil farms costlier than honest work. Each agent must stake a bond and pass a rotating human attestation held on a public terrace, where validators confirm unique identity in person. A whisper of collusion triggers peer review, and a haven of last resort locks suspicious accounts until the terrace ceremony resolves them. In practice, CursorComposer sees clones fail at the grading gate.
